ns2:section.sectionText: Students are required to log in and use Canvas and Zoom in order to complete this course. Verbal and video participation in live class meetings is required. Tuition and fees for a course may vary depending on a number of factors including degree-seeking status, college, semester, and initial year of enrollment. Learn more about Tuition & Fees at https://online.illinois.edu/student-services/online-course-tuition-and-fees.
